camel_example: aliyun ros GetTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --ChangeSetId '1f6521a4-05af-4975-afe9-bc4b45ad0000' --IncludeTags Enabled --IncludePermission Enabled --StackGroupName MyStackGroup --TemplateVersion v1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TemplateId '5ecd1e10-b0e9-4389-a565-e4c15efc0000' --TemplateStage Processed --StackId '4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000'
description_en: Queries the details of a template by specifying a stack, a stack group, a change set, or a custom template
description_zh: 指定资源栈、资源栈组、更改集、自定义模板其中任意信息获取模板详情
kebab_example: aliyun ros get-template --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --change-set-id 1f6521a4-05af-4975-afe9-bc4b45ad0000 --template-id 5ecd1e10-b0e9-4389-a565-e4c15efc0000 --template-version v1 --template-stage Processed --include-permission Enabled --stack-group-name MyStackGroup --include-tags Enabled --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the stack.

You must specify only one of the following parameters: StackId, ChangeSetId, StackGroupName, and TemplateId
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈ID。

您必须且仅能指定StackId、ChangeSetId、StackGroupName和TemplateId其中一个参数
parameters.name: stack_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the stack or stack group to which the template belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 模板所属资源栈或资源栈组的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the change set.

You must specify only one of the following parameters: StackId, ChangeSetId, StackGroupName, and TemplateId
parameters.help_zh:
更改集ID。

您必须且仅能指定StackId、ChangeSetId、StackGroupName和TemplateId其中一个参数
parameters.name: change_set_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the template.

Both shared and private templates are supported. For a shared template, the TemplateId is the same as the TemplateARN. Use this value for the query.

You must specify only one of the following parameters: StackId, ChangeSetId, StackGroupName, and TemplateId
parameters.help_zh:
模板ID。

支持共享的模板和私有模板。共享模板TemplateId与TemplateARN相同，使用该值查询。

您必须且仅能指定StackId、ChangeSetId、StackGroupName和TemplateId其中一个参数
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The version of the template. This parameter takes effect only when TemplateId is specified.  
For a shared template, this parameter is supported only when VersionOption is set to AllVersions. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/194768.html.

Valid values: v1 to v65000, and Draft.
Valid values for shared templates: v1 to v65000
parameters.help_zh:
模板版本。仅在指定TemplateId时生效。  
如果为共享模板，仅当共享模板中的VersionOption取值为AllVersions时，支持指定该参数。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/194768.html.

取值范围：v1～v65000、Draft。
共享模板取值范围：v1～v65000
parameters.name: template_version

parameters.help_en:
The stage of the template. This parameter takes effect only when StackId, ChangeSetId, or StackGroupName is specified.

Valid values:

Processed: the parsed and transformed template. This is the default value.
Original: the original template specified by the user
parameters.help_zh:
模板阶段。仅在指定StackId、ChangeSetId或StackGroupName时生效。

取值：

Processed（默认值）：返回解析转换后的模板。
Original：返回用户指定的原始模板
parameters.name: template_stage

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the sharing information of the template. Valid values:

Enabled: queries the sharing information.

Disabled: does not query the sharing information. This is the default value.

Only the template owner can query the sharing information
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询模板共享信息。取值：

Enabled：查询。

Disabled（默认值）：不查询。

仅限模板拥有者查询
parameters.name: include_permission

parameters.help_en:
The name of the stack group.

You must specify only one of the following parameters: StackId, ChangeSetId, StackGroupName, and TemplateId
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈组名称。

您必须且仅能指定StackId、ChangeSetId、StackGroupName和TemplateId其中一个参数
parameters.name: stack_group_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the tag information. Valid values:

Enabled: queries the tag information.
Disabled: does not query the tag information. This is the default value.  

This parameter takes effect only when TemplateId is specified
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询标签信息。取值：

Enabled：查询。
Disabled（默认值）：不查询。  

仅在指定TemplateId参数时生效
parameters.name: include_tags

AdditionalInfo.description_en: The supplementary information of the public template

ChangeSetId.description_en: The ID of the change set. This parameter is returned only when ChangeSetId is specified
ChangeSetId.description_zh: 更改集ID。仅在指定ChangeSetId时返回该参数

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the template was created. The time is displayed in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format. This parameter is returned only when TemplateId is specified.  

If TemplateVersion is specified, the creation time of the template of the specified version is returned.  
If TemplateVersion is not specified, the creation time of the template of the default version is returned
CreateTime.description_zh:
模板创建时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss。仅在指定TemplateId时返回该参数。  

如果指定了TemplateVersion，则返回指定版本模板的创建时间。  
如果未指定TemplateVersion，则返回默认版本模板的创建时间

Description.description_en: The description of the template. This parameter is returned only when TemplateId is specified
Description.description_zh: 模板描述。仅在指定TemplateId时返回该参数
Description.example: ROS template for create ECS instance.

OwnerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the template belongs. This parameter is returned only when TemplateId is specified
OwnerId.description_zh: 模板所属阿里云账号ID。仅在指定TemplateId时返回该参数

Permissions.description_en:
The sharing status of the template. This parameter is returned only when TemplateId is specified and IncludePermission is set to Enabled.

If TemplateVersion is not specified or does not take effect, the sharing status of the template is returned.  
If TemplateVersion is specified and takes effect, the sharing status of the template associated with the version is returned
Permissions.description_zh:
模板的共享状态。仅在指定TemplateId，且IncludePermission为Enabled时返回该参数。

如果未指定TemplateVersion，或者TemplateVersion不生效，则返回模板的共享状态。  
如果指定了TemplateVersion，并且TemplateVersion生效，则返回版本关联模板的共享状态

AccountId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account with which the template is shared

ShareOption.description_en:
The sharing option.

Valid value: ShareToAccounts, which indicates that the template is shared with other Alibaba Cloud accounts
ShareOption.description_zh:
共享选项。

取值：ShareToAccounts，表示共享给其他阿里云账号

ShareSource.description_en:
The source of the sharing relationship.
Valid values:
ROS: the sharing relationship is established by using the ROS console or API.
ResourceDirectory: the sharing relationship is established for accounts in a resource directory by using the resource sharing feature in Resource Management.

Sharing from ROS and sharing from Resource Directory have independent quotas.
Sharing from Resource Directory cannot be canceled or overwritten by using the ROS console or API.
Sharing from Resource Directory can overwrite sharing from ROS
ShareSource.description_zh:
共享关系的建立来源。
取值：
ROS：通过ROS控制台或API建立共享关系。
ResourceDirectory：在资源管理服务中通过资源共享功能为资源目录中的账号建立共享关系。

来自ROS的共享与来自ResourceDirectory的共享拥有独立的配额。
无法通过ROS控制台或API取消或覆盖来自ResourceDirectory的共享。
来自ResourceDirectory的共享可以覆盖来自ROS的共享

TemplateVersion.description_en:
The shared template version. This parameter is returned when ShareOption is set to ShareToAccounts and VersionOption is set to Specified or Current.

When the TemplateVersion parameter is set to Draft, if the Draft version exists, Draft is returned. If the Draft version does not exist or has been deleted, the current latest version is returned.

Valid values: v1 to v65000, and Draft
TemplateVersion.description_zh:
共享的模板版本。当ShareOption为ShareToAccounts，且VersionOption为Specified或Current时返回该参数。

当指定参数TemplateVersion为Draft时，如果Draft版本存在，则该返回值为Draft；如果Draft版本不存在或已被清除，则该返回值为当前最新版本。

取值范围：v1~v65000、Draft

VersionOption.description_en:
The shared version option. This parameter is returned only when ShareOption is set to ShareToAccounts.

Valid values:
AllVersions: shares all versions of shared template.
Latest: shares only the latest version of shared template. When a new version is added to shared template, the shared version changes accordingly to always remain the latest.
Current: shares only the current latest version of shared template. When a new version is added to shared template, the shared version remains unchanged.
Specified: shares only a specified version of shared template
VersionOption.description_zh:
共享版本选项。仅在ShareOption取值为ShareToAccounts时返回该参数。

取值：
AllVersions：共享模板所有版本。
Latest：只共享模板最新版本。模板版本增加时，共享的版本也随之变化，始终保持最新版本。
Current：只共享模板当前最新版本。模板版本增加时，共享的版本不变。
Specified：只共享模板指定的单个版本

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the stack or stack group to which the template belongs. This parameter is returned only when StackId, ChangeSetId, or StackGroupName is specified
RegionId.description_zh: 模板所属资源栈或资源栈组的地域ID。仅在指定StackId、ChangeSetId或StackGroupName时返回该参数

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

ShareType.description_en:
The sharing type of the template. This parameter is returned only when TemplateId is specified.

Valid values:
Private: the template is owned by the user.
Shared: the template is shared by another user
ShareType.description_zh:
模板的共享类型。仅在指定TemplateId时返回该参数。

取值：
Private：模板为用户自己所拥有。
Shared：模板由其他用户所共享

StackGroupName.description_en: The name of the stack group. This parameter is returned only when StackGroupName is specified
StackGroupName.description_zh: 资源栈组名称。仅在指定StackGroupName时返回该参数

StackId.description_en: The ID of the stack. This parameter is returned only when StackId is specified
StackId.description_zh: 资源栈ID。仅在指定StackId时返回该参数

Key.description_en: The tag key of the template

Value.description_en: The tag value of the template

TemplateARN.description_en: The ARN of the template. This parameter is returned only when TemplateId is specified
TemplateARN.description_zh: 模板ARN。仅在指定TemplateId时返回该参数

TemplateId.description_en:
The ID of the template. This parameter is returned only when TemplateId is specified.

For a shared template, the returned value is the same as the TemplateARN
TemplateId.description_zh:
模板的ID。仅在指定TemplateId时返回。

如果是共享模板，返回结果与TemplateARN相同

TemplateName.description_en:
The name of the template. This parameter is returned only when TemplateId is specified.  

If TemplateVersion is specified, the name of the template associated with the version is returned.    
If TemplateVersion is not specified, the name of the template is returned
TemplateName.description_zh:
模板的名称。仅在指定TemplateId时返回该参数。  

如果指定了TemplateVersion，则返回版本关联的模板名称。    
如果未指定TemplateVersion，则返回模板的名称

TemplateVersion.description_en:
The version of the template. This parameter is returned only when TemplateId is specified.  
If TemplateVersion is not specified or does not take effect, this parameter indicates the current version of the template.

For a shared template, this parameter is returned only when VersionOption is set to AllVersions
TemplateVersion.description_zh:
模板版本。仅在指定TemplateId时返回该参数。  
如果未指定TemplateVersion，或TemplateVersion未生效，则该参数表示模板当前版本。

如果为共享模板，当且仅当VersionOption为AllVersions时，支持返回该参数

UpdateTime.description_en:
The time when the template was last updated. The time is displayed in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format. This parameter is returned only when TemplateId is specified.  

If TemplateVersion is specified, the last update time of the template of the specified version is returned.  
If TemplateVersion is not specified, the last update time of the template is returned
UpdateTime.description_zh:
模板的最后更新时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss。仅在指定TemplateId时返回该参数。  

如果指定了TemplateVersion，则返回指定版本模板的最后更新时间。  
如果未指定TemplateVersion，则返回模板的最后更新时间
